ratios.label: Earnings per share
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the filed EPS row is -11 for FY2024 against -0.106858 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 0.009714. A share-count basis difference moves a filed per-share figure by tens of percent, not by a factor, and the inputs on file do not settle which side is wrong. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the period FY2024 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the period FY2024 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2024, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.note: loss-making in the latest period, so P/E is not meaningful
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2024
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 1.02467e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (the shares outstanding on the statement file (sharesOutstanding))
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E a PEG divides is itself withheld, so there is no P/E to divide by the growth rate. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the FY2024 revenue of 83,706,146 is the filed figure for a company that has not resumed operations, and the market capitalisation it is divided into rests on a stale mark (price 7.10 with zero volume and a 52-week range of 7.10 to 7.10, 2026-10-05), so the P/S is not a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
